body.title: enh: enable maintainer edits by default on new repositories
body.body:
First step of #14229: doesn't close it fully.
The next step would be to migrate to a user setting (enabled by default).

While doing this change of defaults I realized that the default value for those settings is not stored in a central place, leading to potential inconsistencies between the behavior of the API or web UI in various scenarios.

I found one such scenario: the default settings for the pull request unit are not the same for a freshly created repo (where pull requests are enabled by default) and for a repo where the PR unit was disabled and enabled again later.

I'm considering to do a follow-up PR to introduce a central definition of those settings, resolving those inconsistencies and easing the change of defaults in the future.

body.title: fix: reduce memory usage during Actions log & artifacts uploads
body.body:
Fixes #14591.  When an action log is being transferred out of the database and into content storage, it goes through zstd compression.  This causes the file size to be unknown during the save to storage.  Minio defaults to a large 526MB in-memory buffer for each section of the multipart-upload that it will do when the incoming file size is unknown.  This PR provides a more reasonable configured value, 16MB.

Similarly, Actions Artifacts stream their input data straight from an HTTP request without a unknown size, and also provide a `-1` size value to the content storage.

All the allocated memory is pretty easily reclaimable by the GC, but the amount required by the current configuration is certainly unnecessary.

# Manual Testing

Test case: uploading 4 action logs to minio w/ default zstd compression.

body.title: auth/basic: return incorrect credential error on non existent email
body.body:
previously when attempting to use basic authentication with a non existent email address, generic error HTTP 500 would be returned

this change modifies the 401 error condition to also include `ErrEmailAddressNotExist`

for a more detailed explanation, see https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/14634

fixes https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/14634

i didn't include an integration test because i couldn't find an existing one for generic basic auth. if i were to create one, i wouldn't be sure what other cases to test too
